# Purpose

This R Markdown file is the reproducible analytical companion to the manuscript targeted to *ISPRS International Journal of Geo-Information*. The workflow is intentionally framed as district-level geo-information screening. It does **not** fit an ETAS model, estimate earthquake triggering, or produce short-horizon event-count forecasts. Instead, it harmonizes earthquake-source information, fault geometry, Vs30, administrative units, and annual exposure-vulnerability attributes; constructs a GMPE-derived shaking-exceedance proxy; smooths that proxy with an INLA-SPDE latent Gaussian model; and evaluates the stability of an integrated spatial screening score.

**Vulnerability-data revision.** The bundled BPS file does not contain district-level age-group counts or a road-damage variable. To avoid inventing unsupported inputs, the vulnerability component is anchored to an auditable 2024 connectivity proxy derived from the observed `Sinyal` indicator. The proxy is scaled so that lower 2024 connectivity corresponds to higher relative vulnerability. It is a screening proxy, not a demographic vulnerable-age ratio, road-damage measure, or physical-loss estimate. Exposure continues to use the 2019--2025 socioeconomic panel, while vulnerability is anchored to 2024.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
  )

normalize01 <- function(x) {
  rr <- range(x, na.rm=TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rr)) || diff(rr) == 0) return(rep(0, length(x)))
  (x - rr[1]) / diff(rr)
}

rank_stability <- function(base_df, alt_df, id="ID_Kec") {
  z <- inner_join(
    base_df %>% select(all_of(id), Rank_base=Rank),
    alt_df %>% select(all_of(id), Rank_alt=Rank), by=id
  )
  rho <- cor(z$Rank_base, z$Rank_alt, method="spearman", use="complete.obs")
  topn <- min(10, nrow(z))
  a <- z %>% arrange(Rank_base) %>% slice_head(n=topn) %>% pull(all_of(id))
  b <- z %>% arrange(Rank_alt) %>% slice_head(n=topn) %>% pull(all_of(id))
  list(spearman=rho, top10_overlap=length(intersect(a,b))/topn)
}
```

# Spatial harmonization

```{r spatial-harmonization, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Administrative units
layers <- st_layers(file_gpkg)$name
layer_name <- if ("Batas_Desa_Kelurahan_JABAR" %in% layers) "Batas_Desa_Kelurahan_JABAR" else layers[1]
desa_raw <- st_read(file_gpkg, layer=layer_name, quiet=TRUE) %>% st_zm(drop=TRUE, what="ZM") %>% st_make_valid()

kode_target <- c("32.04","32.17","32.03","32.05","32.14","32.13","32.11","32.73","32.77")
desa_study <- desa_raw %>% filter(kd_kab %in% kode_target)

sf_use_s2(FALSE)
# Province-wide kabupaten/kota context for background maps.
jabar_kabkot_sf <- desa_raw %>%
  group_by(kabupaten_kota) %>%
  summarise(do_union=TRUE, .groups="drop") %>%
  st_make_valid()

# Dissolve village/kelurahan polygons to district level for the study area.
# Do not hard-code the active geometry-column name (it can be `geom`,
# `geometry`, or another name depending on the GeoPackage/GDAL build).
kecamatan_sf <- desa_study %>%
  group_by(kabupaten_kota, kecamatan) %>%
  summarise(do_union=TRUE, .groups="drop") %>%
  st_make_valid()

# Outer outline of the study area, useful for context maps.
study_area_outline <- kecamatan_sf %>%
  summarise(do_union=TRUE, .groups="drop") %>%
  st_make_valid()
sf_use_s2(TRUE)
kecamatan_sf$ID_Kec <- seq_len(nrow(kecamatan_sf))

lookup_kec <- kecamatan_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>%
  transmute(ID_Kec, kabupaten=kabupaten_kota, kecamatan)

# Fault from KMZ
read_fault_kmz <- function(path) {
  td <- tempfile(); dir.create(td)
  on.exit(unlink(td, recursive=TRUE), add=TRUE)
  unzip(path, exdir=td)
  kml <- list.files(td, pattern="\\.kml$", full.names=TRUE, recursive=TRUE)
  if (!length(kml)) stop("No KML found inside KMZ")
  st_read(kml[1], quiet=TRUE)
}
fault_sf <- read_fault_kmz(file_fault) %>% st_zm(drop=TRUE, what="ZM") %>% st_make_valid()
fault_sf <- st_transform(fault_sf, st_crs(kecamatan_sf))

# Metric CRS for distance-based operations.
kecamatan_utm <- st_transform(kecamatan_sf, CFG$utm_crs)
fault_utm <- st_transform(fault_sf, CFG$utm_crs)
cent_utm <- st_centroid(kecamatan_utm)
coords_utm <- st_coordinates(cent_utm)

# Distance from district centroid to fault trace.
kecamatan_sf$Distance_to_fault_km <- as.numeric(st_distance(cent_utm, fault_utm) |> apply(1, min)) / 1000

# Vs30: retain physically meaningful (>0) grid cells, intersect with districts.
vs30_pts <- vs30_raw %>%
  filter(is.finite(longitude), is.finite(latitude), is.finite(vs30_mosaic), vs30_mosaic > 0) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords=c("longitude","latitude"), crs=4326) %>%
  st_transform(st_crs(kecamatan_sf))

vs30_kec <- st_join(vs30_pts, kecamatan_sf %>% select(ID_Kec), join=st_within) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  filter(!is.na(ID_Kec)) %>%
  group_by(ID_Kec) %>%
  summarise(Vs30_mean=mean(vs30_mosaic, na.rm=TRUE), Vs30_sd=sd(vs30_mosaic, na.rm=TRUE), n_grid=n(), .groups="drop")

kecamatan_sf <- kecamatan_sf %>% left_join(vs30_kec, by="ID_Kec")

# Spatial nearest-neighbor fill for districts without Vs30 intersections.
vs <- kecamatan_sf$Vs30_mean
missing_vs <- which(!is.finite(vs))
if (length(missing_vs)) {
  valid_vs <- which(is.finite(vs))
  for (ii in missing_vs) {
    dd <- sqrt((coords_utm[ii,1]-coords_utm[valid_vs,1])^2 + (coords_utm[ii,2]-coords_utm[valid_vs,2])^2)
    jj <- order(dd)[seq_len(min(3, length(dd)))]
    w <- (1/pmax(dd[jj],1)); w <- w/sum(w)
    vs[ii] <- sum(vs[valid_vs[jj]]*w)
  }
}
vs[vs < 100] <- 100
kecamatan_sf$Vs30_model <- vs

kable(tibble::tibble(
  SpatialUnit="District (kecamatan)",
  N=nrow(kecamatan_sf),
  CRS_metric=CFG$utm_crs,
  Missing_Vs30_filled=length(missing_vs)
))
```

```{r bps-panel}
unmatched <- panel %>% filter(is.na(ID_Kec)) %>% distinct(Kab.Kota, Kecamatan)
if (nrow(unmatched)) {
  warning("Some BPS district names did not match the GPKG. Inspect object 'unmatched'.")

# Deterministic temporal interpolation used in the working analysis.
impute_temporal <- function(x) {
  if (all(is.na(x))) return(x)
  zoo::na.locf(zoo::na.approx(x, na.rm=FALSE), na.rm=FALSE) |>
    zoo::na.locf(fromLast=TRUE, na.rm=FALSE)
}

panel_imp <- panel %>%
  arrange(ID_Kec, Tahun) %>%
  group_by(ID_Kec) %>%
  mutate(
    Kepadatan = impute_temporal(Kepadatan),
    Faskes = impute_temporal(Faskes),
    Pendidikan = impute_temporal(Pendidikan),
    Sinyal = impute_temporal(Sinyal)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Transform strongly skewed count/density variables.
transform_if_skewed <- function(x, cutoff=1) {
  s <- psych::skew(x, na.rm=TRUE)
  if (is.finite(s) && abs(s) > cutoff && all(x >= 0, na.rm=TRUE)) log1p(x) else x
}
# Auditable 2024 vulnerability proxy from an actually observed BPS variable.
# Lower Sinyal/connectivity -> higher relative vulnerability.
inv_minmax <- function(x) {
  x <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(x))
  good <- is.finite(x)
  out <- rep(NA_real_, length(x))
  if (!any(good)) return(out)
  rng <- range(x[good], na.rm=TRUE)
  if (!all(is.finite(rng)) || diff(rng)==0) {
    out[good] <- 0.5
  } else {
    out[good] <- 1 - (x[good] - rng[1]) / diff(rng)
  }
  out
}

vulnerability_2024 <- panel_imp %>%
  filter(Tahun == 2024, !is.na(ID_Kec)) %>%
  transmute(
    ID_Kec,
    Vulnerability_Proxy_2024 = inv_minmax(Sinyal)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID_Kec) %>%
  summarise(
    Vulnerability_Proxy_2024 = mean(Vulnerability_Proxy_2024, na.rm=TRUE),
    .groups="drop"
  )

panel_imp <- panel_imp %>%
  left_join(vulnerability_2024, by="ID_Kec") %>%
  mutate(
    Kepadatan_t=transform_if_skewed(Kepadatan),
    Faskes_t=transform_if_skewed(Faskes),
    Pendidikan_t=transform_if_skewed(Pendidikan),
    Sinyal_t=transform_if_skewed(Sinyal),
    Vulnerability_Proxy_t=Vulnerability_Proxy_2024
  )
```

# PCA-based component indices

```{r pca-indices}
make_pca_index <- function(df, vars, id="ID_Kec", direction=1) {
  x <- df %>% select(all_of(vars))
  keep <- vapply(x, function(z) sum(is.finite(z)) > 1 && sd(z, na.rm=TRUE) > 0, logical(1))
  x <- x[, keep, drop=FALSE]
  if (!ncol(x)) stop("No usable variables for component index")
  x <- as.data.frame(scale(x))
  if (ncol(x)==1) {
    score <- x[[1]]
    ev <- 1
    load <- 1
  } else {
    p <- prcomp(x, center=FALSE, scale.=FALSE)
    score <- p$x[,1]
    ev <- p$sdev[1]^2/sum(p$sdev^2)
    load <- p$rotation[,1]
  }
  # Orient so larger average raw standardized values correspond to larger score.
  if (cor(score, rowMeans(x), use="complete.obs") < 0) score <- -score
  tibble::tibble(!!id := df[[id]], score=score, explained=ev)
}

build_component_indices <- function(start_year, end_year) {
  dat <- panel_imp %>% filter(Tahun >= start_year, Tahun <= end_year, !is.na(ID_Kec))
  district_avg <- dat %>%
    group_by(ID_Kec) %>%
    summarise(
      Kepadatan_t=mean(Kepadatan_t, na.rm=TRUE),
      Faskes_t=mean(Faskes_t, na.rm=TRUE),
      Pendidikan_t=mean(Pendidikan_t, na.rm=TRUE),
      Sinyal_t=mean(Sinyal_t, na.rm=TRUE),
      Vulnerability_Proxy_t=mean(Vulnerability_Proxy_t, na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups="drop"
    )

  exp_idx <- make_pca_index(district_avg, c("Kepadatan_t","Faskes_t","Pendidikan_t")) %>%
    transmute(ID_Kec, Exp_Index=score, Exp_Explained=explained)

  vul_idx <- make_pca_index(district_avg, c("Vulnerability_Proxy_t")) %>%
    transmute(ID_Kec, Vul_Index=score, Vul_Explained=explained)

  left_join(exp_idx, vul_idx, by="ID_Kec")
}

pca_2019_2025 <- build_component_indices(2019, 2025)
pca_2023_2025 <- build_component_indices(2023, 2025)
pca_2024_2025 <- build_component_indices(2024, 2025)
```

# Earthquake catalog and magnitude harmonization

```{r earthquake-catalog}
convert_to_Mw <- function(M, mag_type) {
  mt <- toupper(trimws(ifelse(is.na(mag_type), "", mag_type)))
  out <- M
  out[mt=="M"] <- 1.0166*M[mt=="M"] - 0.2207
  idx <- mt=="MB" & M <= 6.2; out[idx] <- 0.933*M[idx] + 0.52
  idx <- mt=="MB" & M > 6.2;  out[idx] <- 1.273*M[idx] - 1.2
  idx <- mt %in% c("MLV","ML"); out[idx] <- 0.756*M[idx] + 1.060
  idx <- mt=="MW(MB)"; out[idx] <- 0.898*M[idx] + 0.597
  out
}

eq <- eq_raw %>%
  filter(Tahun >= CFG$hazard_start, Tahun <= CFG$hazard_end) %>%
  mutate(Mw=convert_to_Mw(Magnitude, Mag.Type)) %>%
  filter(is.finite(Latitude), is.finite(Longitude), is.finite(Mw), is.finite(Depth))

eq_sf <- st_as_sf(eq, coords=c("Longitude","Latitude"), crs=4326) %>% st_transform(CFG$utm_crs)
```

# Ground-motion proxy

```{r gmpe}
gmpe_proxy <- function(M, R, Vs30, coeff=CFG$gmpe) {
  dm <- ifelse(M > coeff$Mh, M-coeff$Mh, 0)
  FE <- coeff$c0 + coeff$c1*M + coeff$c2*M^2 + ifelse(M<=coeff$Mh,0,coeff$c4*dm)
  FP <- coeff$c3*log(pmax(R,1)/coeff$Rref) +
    ifelse(M<=coeff$Mh,
           coeff$c4*M*log(pmax(R,1)/coeff$Rref),
           coeff$c4*coeff$Mh*log(pmax(R,1)/coeff$Rref))
  FS_lin <- coeff$c7*log(Vs30/coeff$Vref)
  PGA_ref <- exp(FE+FP)
  f2 <- ifelse(Vs30<=coeff$V1,
               coeff$b1*log(pmax(PGA_ref,1e-8)/0.1),
               ifelse(Vs30<=coeff$V2,
                      coeff$b1*log(pmax(PGA_ref,1e-8)/0.1) +
                        coeff$b2*log(pmax(PGA_ref,1e-8)/0.1)*log(Vs30/coeff$V1)/log(coeff$V2/coeff$V1),
                      0))
  exp(FE+FP+FS_lin+f2)
}

# Mw 6.8 scenario, 10-km depth, district-centroid distance to fault.
R_scen <- sqrt(kecamatan_sf$Distance_to_fault_km^2 + 10^2)
kecamatan_sf$PGA_scenario <- gmpe_proxy(CFG$scenario_mw, R_scen, kecamatan_sf$Vs30_model)
kecamatan_sf$Affected_MMI_VI <- kecamatan_sf$PGA_scenario >= CFG$pga_threshold
```

# Annual district-level hazard proxy

The working analysis defines the annual hazard probability as the proportion of cataloged events in a year whose GMPE-derived PGA at a district exceeds 0.092 g. This is a **model-derived screening probability**, not an empirical exceedance frequency from accelerograph observations.

```{r annual-hazard, cache=TRUE}
# WARNING: this loop can be computationally expensive for the full BMKG catalog.
# To preserve the supplied analysis definition, no arbitrary geographic filter is imposed here.

eq_xy <- st_coordinates(eq_sf)
n_kec <- nrow(kecamatan_sf)
years_h <- CFG$hazard_start:CFG$hazard_end
annual_prob <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n_kec, ncol=length(years_h), dimnames=list(NULL,years_h))
annual_pga_max <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n_kec, ncol=length(years_h), dimnames=list(NULL,years_h))

for (yy in seq_along(years_h)) {
  idx <- which(eq$Tahun == years_h[yy])
  if (!length(idx)) {
    annual_prob[,yy] <- 0.001
    annual_pga_max[,yy] <- 0
    next
  }
  pga_mat <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n_kec, ncol=length(idx))
  for (jj in seq_along(idx)) {
    k <- idx[jj]
    d_h <- sqrt((coords_utm[,1]-eq_xy[k,1])^2 + (coords_utm[,2]-eq_xy[k,2])^2)/1000
    R3 <- sqrt(d_h^2 + eq$Depth[k]^2)
    pga_mat[,jj] <- gmpe_proxy(eq$Mw[k], R3, kecamatan_sf$Vs30_model)
  }
  annual_pga_max[,yy] <- apply(pga_mat,1,max,na.rm=TRUE)
  annual_prob[,yy] <- rowMeans(pga_mat >= CFG$pga_threshold, na.rm=TRUE)
  annual_prob[,yy] <- pmin(pmax(annual_prob[,yy],0.001),0.999)
}

# Align 2019-2025 panel; carry 2024 forward as an explicitly labeled 2025 proxy.
model_years <- CFG$model_years
haz_prob <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow=n_kec, ncol=length(model_years), dimnames=list(NULL,model_years))
for (tt in seq_along(model_years)) {
  if (model_years[tt] <= CFG$hazard_end) haz_prob[,tt] <- annual_prob[,as.character(model_years[tt])]
}
haz_prob[,"2025"] <- haz_prob[,"2024"]
```

# Bayesian INLA-SPDE model

The second-stage model smooths the bounded GMPE-derived district-year exceedance fractions on the logit scale. A Gaussian latent model is fitted to the logit-transformed fractions, with an explicit likelihood-strength weight used only for sensitivity analysis. This avoids converting small continuous exceedance fractions into rounded pseudo-counts, which can collapse all responses to zero when the effective trial count is small.

```{r inla-model, cache=TRUE}
# Mesh
bbox <- st_bbox(kecamatan_utm)
diag_m <- sqrt((bbox$xmax-bbox$xmin)^2 + (bbox$ymax-bbox$ymin)^2)
mesh <- inla.mesh.2d(
  loc=coords_utm,
  boundary=list(inla.nonconvex.hull(coords_utm, convex=-0.05)),
  max.edge=c(0.03,0.08)*diag_m,
  cutoff=0.005*diag_m
)

make_model_data <- function(n_eff=CFG$n_eff) {
  dat <- expand.grid(ID_Kec=seq_len(n_kec), Tahun=model_years) %>%
    arrange(ID_Kec,Tahun) %>% mutate(ID_Tahun=match(Tahun,model_years))
  dat$p_hazard <- mapply(function(i,t) haz_prob[i,as.character(t)], dat$ID_Kec, dat$Tahun)
  dat$p_hazard <- pmin(pmax(dat$p_hazard,0.001),0.999)
  # Preserve small exceedance fractions instead of rounding them to zero.
  dat$Y <- qlogis(dat$p_hazard)
  dat$LikelihoodWeight <- rep(as.numeric(n_eff), nrow(dat))
  dat
}

fit_inla_model <- function(model_type=c("intercept","temporal","spatial","full"), n_eff=CFG$n_eff,
                           range_km=CFG$pc_range_km, sigma0=CFG$pc_sigma) {
  model_type <- match.arg(model_type)
  dat <- make_model_data(n_eff)
  n <- nrow(dat)

  if (model_type %in% c("spatial","full")) {
    spde <- inla.spde2.pcmatern(mesh, alpha=2,
      prior.range=c(range_km*1000, CFG$pc_prob),
      prior.sigma=c(sigma0, CFG$pc_prob))

    if (model_type=="full") {
      A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc=coords_utm[dat$ID_Kec,,drop=FALSE], group=dat$ID_Tahun, n.group=length(model_years))
      idx <- inla.spde.make.index("spatial", n.spde=spde$n.spde, n.group=length(model_years))
      fx <- data.frame(Intercept=rep(1, n), ID_Tahun=dat$ID_Tahun)
      stopifnot(nrow(A) == n, nrow(fx) == n)
      stk <- inla.stack(data=list(Y=dat$Y), A=list(A,1), effects=list(idx,fx), tag="est")
      form <- Y ~ -1 + Intercept + f(spatial, model=spde, group=spatial.group, control.group=list(model="iid")) + f(ID_Tahun, model="rw1")
    } else {
      A <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc=coords_utm[dat$ID_Kec,,drop=FALSE])
      idx <- inla.spde.make.index("spatial", n.spde=spde$n.spde)
      fx <- data.frame(Intercept=rep(1, n))
      stopifnot(nrow(A) == n, nrow(fx) == n)
      stk <- inla.stack(data=list(Y=dat$Y), A=list(A,1), effects=list(idx,fx), tag="est")
      form <- Y ~ -1 + Intercept + f(spatial, model=spde)
    }
  } else {
    fx <- data.frame(Intercept=rep(1, n), ID_Tahun=dat$ID_Tahun)
    stopifnot(nrow(fx) == n)
    stk <- inla.stack(data=list(Y=dat$Y), A=list(1), effects=list(fx), tag="est")
    form <- if (model_type=="temporal") Y ~ -1 + Intercept + f(ID_Tahun, model="rw1") else Y ~ -1 + Intercept
  }

  fit <- inla(
    form,
    data=inla.stack.data(stk),
    family="gaussian",
    weights=dat$LikelihoodWeight,
    control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(stk), compute=TRUE),
    control.compute=list(dic=TRUE, waic=TRUE, cpo=TRUE, config=TRUE),
    control.inla=list(strategy="gaussian", int.strategy="eb"),
    verbose=FALSE
  )

  idata <- inla.stack.index(stk,"est")$data

  # Transform posterior summaries from the logit scale back to the
  # annual exceedance-fraction scale.
  lp <- fit$summary.linear.predictor[idata,,drop=FALSE]
  p_linkmean <- plogis(lp$mean)
  p_q025 <- plogis(lp$`0.025quant`)
  p_q975 <- plogis(lp$`0.975quant`)

  post_year <- tibble::tibble(
    ID_Kec=dat$ID_Kec,
    Tahun=dat$Tahun,
    p_hazard_input=dat$p_hazard,
    posterior_exceedance=p_linkmean,
    fitted_mean=p_linkmean,
    fitted_sd=(p_q975-p_q025)/3.92,
    q025=p_q025,
    q975=p_q975
  )

  post <- post_year %>%
    group_by(ID_Kec) %>%
    summarise(
      p_mean_avg=mean(posterior_exceedance,na.rm=TRUE),
      fitted_mean_avg=mean(fitted_mean,na.rm=TRUE),
      fitted_sd_avg=mean(fitted_sd,na.rm=TRUE),
      q025_avg=mean(q025,na.rm=TRUE),
      q975_avg=mean(q975,na.rm=TRUE),
      ci_width_avg=mean(q975-q025,na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups="drop"
    )

  metrics <- tibble::tibble(
    Model=model_type,
    DIC=fit$dic$dic,
    WAIC=fit$waic$waic,
    SumLogCPO=sum(log(fit$cpo$cpo),na.rm=TRUE),
    CPO_Failure=sum(fit$cpo$failure>0,na.rm=TRUE)
  )
  list(fit=fit, data=dat, stack=stk, posterior=post, posterior_year=post_year, metrics=metrics)
}

fits <- lapply(c("intercept","temporal","spatial","full"), fit_inla_model)
names(fits) <- c("intercept","temporal","spatial","full")
model_comparison <- bind_rows(lapply(fits, `[[`, "metrics")) %>% arrange(DIC)

# Export diagnostics for the Shiny app only after the INLA models have actually run.
derived_dir <- file.path(dirname(DATA_DIR), "derived")
dir.create(derived_dir, showWarnings=FALSE, recursive=TRUE)
readr::write_csv(model_comparison, file.path(derived_dir, "model_comparison_live.csv"))

kable(model_comparison, digits=2)

final_fit <- fits$full

# Export the posterior fitted exceedance-screening surface used by the paper.
posterior_year_live <- final_fit$posterior_year %>%
  left_join(lookup_kec,by="ID_Kec")

posterior_summary_live <- final_fit$posterior %>%
  left_join(lookup_kec,by="ID_Kec")

readr::write_csv(
  posterior_year_live,
  file.path(derived_dir,"posterior_exceedance_year_live.csv")
)
readr::write_csv(
  posterior_summary_live,
  file.path(derived_dir,"posterior_exceedance_summary_live.csv")
)

# Supplementary high-resolution visualization of the fitted full SPDE model.
# This does NOT downscale exposure/vulnerability and is therefore not an
# integrated high-resolution risk map. It is a continuous posterior shaking-
# screening surface implied by the SPDE component.
try({
  spatial_sum <- final_fit$fit$summary.random$spatial
  temporal_sum <- final_fit$fit$summary.random$ID_Tahun
  intercept_mean <- as.numeric(final_fit$fit$summary.fixed["Intercept","mean"])

  n_spde <- mesh$n
  n_year <- length(model_years)

  if(!is.null(spatial_sum) &&
     nrow(spatial_sum) >= n_spde*n_year &&
     !is.null(temporal_sum)) {

    spatial_mean <- matrix(
      spatial_sum$mean[seq_len(n_spde*n_year)],
      nrow=n_spde,
      ncol=n_year
    )

    temp_mean <- rep(0,n_year)
    if("mean" %in% names(temporal_sum)){
      jj <- seq_len(min(n_year,nrow(temporal_sum)))
      temp_mean[jj] <- temporal_sum$mean[jj]
    }

    bb_hr <- sf::st_bbox(study_area_outline)
    grid_res_m <- 1000

    xs <- seq(
      floor(bb_hr["xmin"]/grid_res_m)*grid_res_m,
      ceiling(bb_hr["xmax"]/grid_res_m)*grid_res_m,
      by=grid_res_m
    )
    ys <- seq(
      floor(bb_hr["ymin"]/grid_res_m)*grid_res_m,
      ceiling(bb_hr["ymax"]/grid_res_m)*grid_res_m,
      by=grid_res_m
    )

    proj_hr <- inla.mesh.projector(
      mesh,
      xlim=range(xs),
      ylim=range(ys),
      dims=c(length(xs),length(ys))
    )

    p_stack <- vector("list",n_year)
    for(tt in seq_len(n_year)){
      sp_grid <- inla.mesh.project(proj_hr,spatial_mean[,tt])
      p_stack[[tt]] <- plogis(intercept_mean + sp_grid + temp_mean[tt])
    }

    p_hr <- Reduce("+",p_stack)/n_year
    grd <- expand.grid(x=proj_hr$x,y=proj_hr$y)
    grd$posterior_exceedance_hr <- as.vector(p_hr)

    grd_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grd,coords=c("x","y"),crs=32748,remove=FALSE)
    inside <- lengths(sf::st_within(grd_sf,study_area_outline))>0
    grd_sf <- grd_sf[inside,]

    grd_wgs <- sf::st_transform(grd_sf,4326)
    xy_wgs <- sf::st_coordinates(grd_wgs)

    hr_out <- tibble::tibble(
      longitude=xy_wgs[,1],
      latitude=xy_wgs[,2],
      posterior_exceedance_hr=grd_sf$posterior_exceedance_hr
    ) %>%
      filter(is.finite(posterior_exceedance_hr))

    readr::write_csv(
      hr_out,
      file.path(derived_dir,"posterior_spde_highres_live.csv")
    )
  }
},silent=TRUE)
```

```{r risk-score}
W <- c(H=0.60,E=0.30,V=0.10)
```

# Sensitivity analysis

```{r sensitivity, cache=TRUE}
# Screening-score weight sensitivity
weight_sets <- list(
  `60:30:10`=c(H=.60,E=.30,V=.10),
  `50:25:25`=c(H=.50,E=.25,V=.25),
  `50:30:20`=c(H=.50,E=.30,V=.20),
  `70:20:10`=c(H=.70,E=.20,V=.10)
)

make_rank <- function(post,pca,W) {
  post %>% left_join(pca,by="ID_Kec") %>%
    mutate(H=normalize01(p_mean_avg),E=normalize01(Exp_Index),V=normalize01(Vul_Index),
           Screening_Score=100*(W["H"]*H+W["E"]*E+W["V"]*V)) %>%
    arrange(desc(Screening_Score)) %>% mutate(Rank=row_number())
}

base_rank <- make_rank(final_fit$posterior,pca_2019_2025,weight_sets[["60:30:10"]])
weight_sens <- bind_rows(lapply(names(weight_sets), function(nm) {
  rr <- make_rank(final_fit$posterior,pca_2019_2025,weight_sets[[nm]])
  st <- rank_stability(base_rank,rr)
  tibble::tibble(Scenario=nm,Spearman=st$spearman,Top10_Overlap=st$top10_overlap)
}))

# PCA-window sensitivity
pca_sets <- list(`2019-2025`=pca_2019_2025,`2023-2025`=pca_2023_2025,`2024-2025`=pca_2024_2025)
pca_sens <- bind_rows(lapply(names(pca_sets), function(nm) {
  rr <- make_rank(final_fit$posterior,pca_sets[[nm]],weight_sets[["60:30:10"]])
  st <- rank_stability(base_rank,rr)
  tibble::tibble(Scenario=nm,Spearman=st$spearman,Top10_Overlap=st$top10_overlap)
}))

# n_eff sensitivity
neff_sens <- bind_rows(lapply(c(2,3,5,10), function(ne) {
  ff <- fit_inla_model("full", n_eff=ne)
  rr <- make_rank(ff$posterior,pca_2019_2025,weight_sets[["60:30:10"]])
  st <- rank_stability(base_rank,rr)
  tibble::tibble(n_eff=ne,DIC=ff$metrics$DIC,WAIC=ff$metrics$WAIC,Spearman=st$spearman,Top10_Overlap=st$top10_overlap)
}))

# PC-prior sensitivity
prior_grid <- bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(range_km=c(10,20,40),sigma0=CFG$pc_sigma),
  tibble::tibble(range_km=CFG$pc_range_km,sigma0=c(0.5,1.0))
) %>% distinct()
prior_sens <- purrr::pmap_dfr(prior_grid, function(range_km,sigma0) {
  ff <- fit_inla_model("full", range_km=range_km, sigma0=sigma0)
  rr <- make_rank(ff$posterior,pca_2019_2025,weight_sets[["60:30:10"]])
  st <- rank_stability(base_rank,rr)
  tibble::tibble(range_km=range_km,sigma0=sigma0,DIC=ff$metrics$DIC,WAIC=ff$metrics$WAIC,Spearman=st$spearman,Top10_Overlap=st$top10_overlap)
})

# Export manuscript-ready sensitivity results used by the companion Shiny app.
sensitivity_live <- bind_rows(
  weight_sens %>% transmute(
    sensitivity_factor="H:E:V weights",
    setting=Scenario,
    spearman_rho=Spearman,
    top10_overlap=Top10_Overlap
  ),
  pca_sens %>% transmute(
    sensitivity_factor="Averaging period",
    setting=Scenario,
    spearman_rho=Spearman,
    top10_overlap=Top10_Overlap
  ),
  neff_sens %>% transmute(
    sensitivity_factor="Effective likelihood strength",
    setting=as.character(n_eff),
    spearman_rho=Spearman,
    top10_overlap=Top10_Overlap,
    DIC=DIC,
    WAIC=WAIC
  ),
  prior_sens %>% transmute(
    sensitivity_factor="PC prior (range, SD)",
    setting=paste0("(",range_km," km, ",sigma0,")"),
    spearman_rho=Spearman,
    top10_overlap=Top10_Overlap,
    DIC=DIC,
    WAIC=WAIC
  )
)

readr::write_csv(
  sensitivity_live,
  file.path(derived_dir,"sensitivity_analysis_live.csv")
)

readr::write_csv(
  screening %>% slice_head(n=10) %>%
    select(Rank,kabupaten,kecamatan,Screening_Score,p_mean_avg),
  file.path(derived_dir,"top10_screening_live.csv")
)

# Manuscript-ready outputs
manuscript_dir <- file.path(dirname(DATA_DIR),"manuscript")
dir.create(manuscript_dir,showWarnings=FALSE,recursive=TRUE)
```

```r
)
```

For the dashboard workflow, the same Rmd can be called with `run_pandoc = FALSE`; all analytical chunks and CSV/PNG exports are still executed.
